title: Macron deploys 'military means' to address international crises and fuel prices
subhead: In an interview, the president said he would 'do everything to reopen the Strait of Hormuz' and did not rule out lowering taxes if fuel prices continued to soar.

title: Mbappé scores but suffers knee injury as Zidane gets debut France win
subhead: Kylian Mbappé, France's all-time top scorer, scored the only goal of the France-Turkey match. It was new coach Zinédine Zidane's first game in charge. France will now go to Brussels to face Belgium on Monday.

title: Pope Leo XIV, pop-star pontiff, puts musical tastes on display in France
subhead: Leo is a connoisseur of Bob Dylan and a fan of Italian singer Laura Pausini. On Friday, at the Stade de France, alongside the prayer vigil, a dozen rather unknown French-speaking artists are scheduled to perform.
